column1: # p503 2026-10-28 — channel boundary map. Three probes per HTTP channel; 000 = agent-proxy CONNECT refused (host not permitted).

column6: WORKS for ANY public repo — total_count, stars, forks, topics, license.spdx_id, created_at, pushed_at, archived
REFUSED: "repository is not configured for this session" — per-repository authorisation. Licence BYTES cannot come from this channel
WORKS — the only byte channel for arbitrary repos
BLOCKED — the LMS plugin registry axis Gap 500-A asked for is unreachable, not unmined
WORKS, RATE-LIMITED — a non-GitHub forge IS reachable (4/6 probes 200); retry with backoff
